name: Opus 55 Video
tagline: Opus 55 Video turns a product URL or prompt into a short Sketch or Motion MP4.
description:
Opus 55 Video turns a product URL or prompt into a short Sketch or Motion MP4. AI writes animation as code; the browser renders the video.

Watch out: the page says this is an independent product, not affiliated with Anthropic. On 2026-11-14 a banner advertised 50% off every plan and credit pack until November 30. The first 10-second video is described as free.
